title: oxytropis leucantha var. depressa
intro: Oxytropis leucantha var. depressa, commonly known as the White Oxytropis or White Mountain Milkvetch, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, as well as its therapeutic actions of reducing fever and treating respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Oxytropis leucantha var. depressa include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. Further research is required to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
